goal: Test whether headband plus clothing improves world-root observability and produces faithful feasible references for frozen official035, with actual robot outcomes required later.
scope: Independent side conversation; do not resume main A3 experiments or use their experiment IDs.
hypothesis: After time and dynamic head/pelvis compensation, weighting reference corrections by frozen-controller directional response sensitivity improves faithful tracking over calibrated geometric/uncertainty-only fusion. No timing changes in first comparison.
novelty: Candidate only; visual-inertial mocap, head-body decoupling, uncertainty fusion and contact correction already exist.
